mira (prod): Quick heads-up — planning a deploy for the customer-rate-limiter refactor at 16:30 PST (~30m). Can owners confirm rollback hooks + runbook are green?
alex (infra): I can take rollback responsibility. I’ll be at my desk during window.
sam (sre): @alex thanks. I’ll verify smoke tests and run the preflight now.
tasha (owner): I’m the feature owner. Rolling back is allowed if error-rate > 2% for 5m or 95th latency regression > 200ms.
mira (prod): That matches the rollback criteria in the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rlb-rate-limiter (see *Criteria* section).
alex (infra): Confirmed: the rollback job exists and is idempotent. Command we run is: ```bash
redwood rollback --deployment-rate-limiter --to-tag v1.8.2 --force-confirm
```
sam (sre): I ran the preflight smoke locally against staging. Key checks: auth tokens, redis TTLs, and metrics emitter. All green. Paste logs snippet: ```
[smoke] redis ok
[smoke] tokens ok
[smoke] metrics OK
```
mira (prod): Thanks. Two quick Qs: 1) Who will post the go/no-go at +10m? 2) If we see a small error spike, do we wait or rollback immediately?
tasha (owner): I’ll post go/no-go at +10. For small spike (<1.5% and <3min) we monitor; for anything meeting the criteria I stated earlier we rollback immediately.
alex (infra): Can someone enable extra logging on the limiter for the first 15m? I’ll toggle the flag. @deploy-bot can you annotate the deploy with the owner + rollback command?
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by mira at 16:30 PST. Metadata: owner=tasha, rollback_cmd="redwood rollback --deployment-rate-limiter --to-tag v1.8.2 --force-confirm".
sam (sre): I'll watch the dashboards and runbook play: checklist items 1-6. If anything hits, I’ll call the rollback and ping channel.
mira (prod): Perfect. Summary: deploy at 16:30 PST, owners: tasha (feature), alex (rollback exec), sam (monitoring). Rollback criteria = error-rate >2% for 5m OR 95th latency +200ms. Go/no-go posted by tasha at +10. Logging flag = alex toggles for first 15m.
tasha (owner): :thumbsup: I’ll post go/no-go at 16:40 PST.
alex (infra): Ready on my side. I’ll stand by.
sam (sre): Monitoring hooks live. Will escalate to #incidents if we need on-call.
mira (prod): Thanks team, I’m OOO at deploy but reachable on DM. Good luck.
tasha (owner): go — provisioning deploy now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by tasha at 16:30:12 PST.
sam (sre): smoke checks passing first minute.
alex (infra): Logging flag enabled.
# (10 minutes later) tasha (owner): go/no-go: GO. No criteria met, minor 0.4% transient spike resolved. Proceeding to full rollout. :party_parrot:
